text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"Cambridge, MA","level":"city","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance: source of income (including Section 8 and public benefits) protected in tenant selection","requirement":"The Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance (ch. 14.04) lists source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits, as a protected category. It prohibits discrimination in viewing or renting an apartment and in the terms and conditions of tenancy. Landlords, sellers and rental agents may use any reasonable standard to select applicants if it is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
